village_elder.name: Elder Alric
village_elder.title: Village Elder
village_elder.description: The wise elder of Oakrest Village

greeting: Welcome, traveler. I am Elder Alric.
Greetings, young one. The village awaits your aid.
Ah, a new face in Oakrest. Come, let us speak.
farewell: May the light guide your path, traveler.
Farewell. Return when you have need.
quest_offer: I have a matter that requires your attention.
The village faces a trials that only a brave soul can address.
Will you lend your strength to Oakrest?
quest_active: How fares your quest? The village watches with hope.
Progress report, traveler. What news do you bring?
The task remains unfinished. Stay focused.
quest_complete: You have done well, traveler. The village owes you a debt.
Excellent work! Your efforts have not gone unnoticed.
The spirits smile upon you for your service.
lore: Oakrest Village has stood for three hundred years, founded by the first settlers of Greenhaven Valley.
The forest to the north hides many secrets, but also great danger.
Legend speaks of an ancient power sealed beneath the Whispering Caverns.
The people of Oakrest value honor, courage, and community above all.

main_menu.text: How can I assist you today?

options.text: Do you have any tasks for me?
Tell me about the surrounding areas
Tell me more about the founders

founder_lore.text: The founders were a band of warriors and scholars who sought refuge from the Great War. They found this valley and built something lasting.

threat_lore.text: The Moss Slimes have grown bolder near the village, and reports of wolves in the forest trouble me greatly. Something stirs in the shadows.

area_lore.text: To the north lies Mosswood Forest, home to slimes and wolves. Further north, the Whispering Caverns hold darker secrets. To the southeast, the Hunter's Camp serves as a base for rangers.

forest_lore.text: Mosswood Forest is ancient and dense. Moss Slimes dwell in its damp undergrowth, while Forest Wolves roam the deeper paths. Collect their pelts, but tread carefully.

cavern_lore.text: The Whispering Caverns... a place of both wonder and dread. Thorn Wisps haunt its passages, and there are rumors of a guardian deep within. I advise caution.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Thoren
blacksmith.title: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: The village blacksmith who forges weapons and armor

greeting: Welcome to my forge! What can I do for you?
Need some new gear? You've come to the right place!
Ah, a customer! Browse my wares at your leisure.
farewell: Come back anytime you need repairs!
shop: Take a look at what I've forged!
Only the finest weapons and armor here!
Each piece crafted with care and quality.
buy: Good choice! That'll serve you well.
This weapon has been tempered to perfection.
sell: Hmm, let me take a look... I'll give you a fair price.
I can work with this. Here's what I'll offer.
no_gold: You'll need more coin for that one.
That piece costs a pretty penny. Come back when you've saved up.
Gold first, then goods. That's how trade works.
lore: I learned my craft from my father, who learned from his before him.
Good steel is hard to come by these days. The mines have been quiet.
A blacksmith is only as good as his tools, and mine have served me well.

main_menu.text: What can I do for you today?

weapons_shop.text: Here are the finest blades in the valley!

armor_shop.text: Protection is worth its weight in gold!

options.text: How did you become a blacksmith?

origin_lore.text: My father taught me the ways of the forge when I was just a boy. He said a true blacksmith must understand fire, metal, and the heart of the one who wields the blade.

weapon_lore.text: A good weapon is balanced, sharp, and true to its purpose. But the finest weapons... they have a spirit. You'll know it when you hold one.

greeting: Looking for something special? You've come to the right place!
Greetings, traveler! I have goods from across the valley.
farewell: May your purse be ever full!
shop: Take a look at my collection!
Everything you need for your adventures!
lore: I travel between villages, gathering goods and news.
The roads are safer than they used to be, but still exercise caution.
Trade is the lifeblood of these settlements.

main_menu.text: What brings you to my shop?

road_lore.text: The roads have been quiet lately, but I've heard rumors of strange lights in the Whispering Caverns. Be careful if you venture that way.

innkeeper.name: Innkeeper Mara
innkeeper.title: Innkeeper
innkeeper.description: Runs the local inn and provides rest for travelers

greeting: Come in, come in! What can I do for you?
Ah, a weary traveler! Let me help you rest.
farewell: Come back whenever you need rest!
service: I can offer you a good rest or healing for a fair price.
Tired? A night's rest will do you wonders.
Wounded? I know a thing or two about healing.
rest: You look refreshed! A good night's rest works wonders.
Sleep well, traveler. You're fully restored.
The innkeeper's touch heals all wounds... eventually.
heal: Let me tend to those wounds.
A little care and you'll be good as new.
The healing arts are my second specialty.
lore: The Restful Oak has hosted travelers for over a century.
I keep the inn running, but my true passion is herbalism.
Many adventurers have passed through these doors.

main_menu.text: What can I do for you?

rest_complete.text: You feel fully refreshed! All health and mana restored.

heal_complete.text: Your wounds have been tended to. You feel much better!

options.text: How long have you run this inn?

history_lore.text: I've run the Restful Oak for twenty years now. My mother ran it before me, and her mother before that. Three generations of hospitality!

herbal_lore.text: The forest provides many herbs with healing properties. I use them in my potions and remedies. It's honest work, and it helps people.

ranger.name: Ranger Elias
ranger.title: Hunter's Camp Ranger
ranger.description: Guides hunters and offers quests to protect the village

greeting: The forest needs protectors like you.
I have work for a skilled hunter.
quest_offer: The wolves have been getting bold. Need someone to thin their numbers.
There's trouble in the Whispering Caverns. Interested?
I have contracts for capable hunters.
lore: The Hunter's Camp has guarded Oakrest for generations.
We track threats before they reach the village.
The forest respects those who respect it.

main_menu.text: What brings you to the Hunter's Camp?

options.text: What creatures lurk in the forest?

creature_lore.text: Moss Slimes are common but harmless if you keep your distance. Forest Wolves are the real threat - they hunt in packs and are relentless once they have your scent.

hunting_lore.text: Patience is key. Watch your target, learn its patterns, and strike when it's vulnerable. Never fight more than one wolf at a time if you can help it.
